title: save
description: Hand an edited store file to the service to write; a `bytes` over the request limit travels as a chunked member (section 2.7), this is the message as read. Endpoint: admin; direction: a2s; phase A. Unknown members are ignored by the reader (protocol.md section 8).

keys.description: The primary's new keys when its file is re-keyed (section 6.4).

previousOuterKey.description: [C] The old repository key the re-keyed file keeps a second slot for: a guided rotation of the repository key alone (section 6.4).

recipients.description: [C] A shared vault's recipients file (an age file), written beside the re-keyed vault in the same commit: a member removed (section 6.4); only with a re-keyed save.
